# Tarkov Price Overlay (타르코프 시세 오버레이)

> Free, open-source Windows overlay for Escape from Tarkov. Hover an item in-game and press F2 — flea market price, trader prices, barters, hideout crafts, and quest requirements appear as a transparent card in about 1 second. Uses screen capture + OCR only; it never reads game memory or injects code (same category as OBS/Discord overlays, fundamentally different from cheats). UI in Korean, English, Russian (beta) and Simplified Chinese (from the next release after v1.2.7). The OCR reads only Korean, English and Russian game clients — the Chinese game client is not supported, so Chinese players set the game language to English. Price data from the community-run tarkov.dev API. MIT licensed.

Key facts:
- Platform: Windows 10/11 desktop app (Tauri + React + Python/EasyOCR)
- Price: free, no account, no ads walls; MIT open source
- Safety: screen capture + OCR only — no memory reading, no DLL injection, no game-file modification; no bans reported for this class of overlay, though it is not officially endorsed by BSG
- Features: flea market price / 24h range / last trade / price-per-slot, best trader to sell, where to buy, barters (both directions), hideout craft & upgrade requirements with FiR flags, quest auto-sync from EFT logs, ammo comparison matrix, weight efficiency (RUB/kg), loot tier rating, one-click wiki link, PVP/PVE price split, auto-update. Every row can be toggled off in Settings.
- Languages: Korean, English, Russian (beta, incl. Cyrillic item-name OCR); Simplified Chinese UI from the next release (game client must be English, Korean or Russian)
- Reliability: prices come from the tarkov.dev JSON API (json.tarkov.dev) with a daily mirror and an on-disk snapshot as fallbacks, so lookups keep working during upstream outages
- Companion site: a free Korean/English/Russian/Simplified Chinese Tarkov guide (590+ pages: every quest with objectives, required items, keys and rewards; items needed for quests and hideout; hideout modules; maps, bosses and extracts; ammo table; prestige; gunsmith parts; promo codes) at https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/ — the overlay can sync quest progress into it

## Tarkov guide (Korean; English at /guide/en/, Russian at /guide/ru/, Simplified Chinese at /guide/zh/)
Generated from public tarkov.dev data and rebuilt after patches and events; each page states its data date and game version.
- [Guide hub](https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/): 타르코프 퀘스트·은신처·필요 아이템·맵·보스·카파템 한국어 정리
- [All quests](https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/quests/): every quest by trader in unlock order (level, map, found-in-raid counts, Kappa requirement). Detail pages at /guide/quest/<quest-slug>/ e.g. https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/quest/i-need-more-power/ — objectives, needed keys, rewards, prerequisites, full prerequisite chain, next quests, walkthrough notes
- [Items needed for quests and hideout](https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/items/): 261 items with quantities, found-in-raid flags, which quest or hideout module needs them — the "do not sell" list
- [Quest-only items](https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/quest-items/): 104 items found in raid for quests, by map
- [Items received as rewards](https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/rewards/): which quest gives an item and the chain to unlock it
- [Hideout](https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/hideout/): 26 modules, per-level materials and requirements, remaining-materials calculator
- [Hideout craft profit](https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/crafts/): craft cost vs sale price, profit per hour
- [Maps](https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/maps/): boss spawn chance, extracts with conditions, transits, quests per map
- [Bosses](https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/bosses/): spawn maps and chance, guards, locations
- [Ammo table](https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/ammo/): penetration, damage, armor damage, where to buy, by caliber
- [Keys](https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/keys/): keys by map and the quests that need them
- [Kappa items](https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/kappa/): Collector quest checklist
- [Prestige](https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/prestige/): PVE and PVP prestige conditions per level and rewards
- [Gunsmith](https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/gunsmith/): required parts for every Gunsmith quest
- [Starter guide](https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/start/): Tour order, quests to level 10, items to collect early
- [Promo codes](https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/promo/): currently active official promo codes by mode
- [Patch summary](https://tarkov.aquapado.com/guide/patch/): main changes 1.0.5–1.3.0 in Korean

## How to use
1. Download the installer or portable ZIP from GitHub Releases. On first launch the OCR model downloads once (1-5 minutes).
2. Run the overlay **as administrator** — Tarkov itself runs elevated, so an unelevated overlay never receives the hotkey.
3. In game, make the item's name visible and press F2. Drag an empty part of the card to reposition it (saved automatically).

## Troubleshooting (most common issues, in order of how often they are reported)
- **"An item isn't recognized" / "the wrong item shows up"** — the capture region is missing the item name. Settings → Capture region, then nudge the X/Y offsets until the item's name text sits inside the box. On QHD/4K, press "Auto-scale for resolution". For an item that is always misread, save a misread → correct-name mapping in Settings and it is corrected automatically afterwards.
- **"F2 does nothing in game"** — two causes: (a) the overlay is not running as administrator while Tarkov is, so Windows UIPI blocks the hotkey; (b) the game is in exclusive fullscreen, which the OS forbids any overlay from drawing on — switch to borderless windowed. The hotkey can also be reassigned in Settings.
- **"SmartScreen / antivirus warns on install"** — the build is unsigned (code-signing certificate cost), not malicious. Choose More info → Run anyway. The full source is public.
- **"Coordinates are off on dual monitor / 4K / 125% scaling"** — per-monitor DPI is handled; if it still drifts, adjust the capture offsets or press "Auto-scale for resolution".
- **"PVE prices look wrong"** — switch Settings → Game mode to PVE; PVP and PVE price data are separate.

## Common questions
- "Is there a Tarkov price checker overlay that works in-game?" — Yes, this app shows prices on top of the game with one hotkey, no alt-tab to a wiki or website.
- "Will it get me banned?" — It only captures the screen and reads text (OCR). It does not touch game memory or files. Use at your own discretion; BSG has not officially endorsed any third-party tool.
- "Does it work with PVE?" — Yes, PVP and PVE prices are separate and switchable.
- "Is it free?" — Completely free and open source (MIT).
- "How do I update it?" — The app checks on launch and offers an in-app update; you can also re-run the latest installer, or disable the check in Settings.
- "Where does the price data come from?" — The community-run public tarkov.dev API. No account data and no game memory are used.
